fields.description: Issue features editorials and commentary on Miami Beach gambling and bookmaking being "closed" due to a struggle between rival gambling groups, with discussion of impacts on hotels and local families. Additional pieces address Miami municipal politics and patronage, controversy over the proposed public library site (Bayfront Park vs. Lummus Park), labor and union matters, criticism of the American Medical Association’s stance on national health insurance, and analysis of Federal Reserve Board income figures; includes regular columns, advertisements, and local notices.
